title: Per-question intelligence record
description: One analytical record over a single real previous-year question (SESSION 009 / SPEC-PYQ-002). It is an ANALYSIS of a T2_HISTORICAL_PYQ question, not new evidence: the underlying question stays authoritative, and this record only classifies it and attaches methods, traps and confusions. Every claim carries an analysis_origin so a model-derived claim can never be mistaken for a sourced one. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/pyq/test_pyq_intelligence.py (D-0006).

question_id.description: Must resolve to a real record in pyq/questions/. An intelligence record with no real question is unsourced.

paper_id.description: Must match the referenced question record's paper_id and resolve to a registered paper.

source_question_number.description: Position in the printed paper, copied from the question record.

source_page_number.description: Page copied from the question record.

subject.description: The subject the question sits in, from the question record (e.g. 'Arithmetic & Test of Reasoning / Mental Ability').

topic.description: Fine-grained topic assigned by this analysis. null only when genuinely unresolved.

question_type.description: The cognitive kind of the question.

question_family_id.description: The family this question belongs to. null when unresolved.

kind.description: STRUCTURAL = a structural property of the question (set form, relationship, arrangement); KEYWORD = a surface word. STRUCTURAL clues are first-class and preferred.

identification_clues.description: How this question's family is recognised. Structural clues first; a junk keyword list is not identification.

required_concept_id.description: The concept this question tests. null when unresolved.

standard_method_id.description: The canonical standard method. If present it must exist in the method register and be OBSERVED_STANDARD or MODEL_DERIVED.

candidate_fast_method_id.description: A candidate fast method, if one was identified. Always present-or-null alongside fast_method_state.

fast_method_verified_id.description: The verification evidence, required iff fast_method_state == VERIFIED_FAST_METHOD.

common_trap_ids.description: Traps this question family sets. May be empty.

confusing_family_ids.description: Families this is commonly confused with. May be empty.

how_to_distinguish.description: How to tell this from each confusing family.

unresolved.description: true only when this analysis could not confidently assign a family. An unresolved record keeps topic/family null rather than guessing.

analysis_origin.description: How the classification was produced. MODEL_DERIVED is this model's analysis of T2 evidence and is not independently verified. EXPERT_SOURCED requires a non-Instagram/YouTube source recorded in provenance.

evidence_tier.description: The underlying question is T2. The analysis is a claim over that evidence, not new evidence.

source_document_id.description: The paper id (PAPER-PYQ-XXXX) this question came from.

expert_source_ref.description: Required iff analysis_origin == EXPERT_SOURCED. A source reference that is not Instagram or YouTube.

invariants: question_id must resolve to a real record in pyq/questions/; an intelligence record with no question is unsourced
paper_id must match the referenced question record's paper_id AND resolve to a registered paper
fast_method_state == VERIFIED_FAST_METHOD  =>  fast_method_verified_id is non-null and resolves to a verification record whose result is PASS
fast_method_state in (UNVERIFIED_FAST_METHOD, VERIFIED_FAST_METHOD)  =>  candidate_fast_method_id is non-null; NO_FAST_METHOD_FOUND => it is null
unresolved == true  =>  question_family_id, topic, required_concept_id and standard_method_id are all null
analysis_origin == EXPERT_SOURCED  =>  provenance.expert_source_ref is non-null and is not an Instagram or YouTube URL
analysis_origin == MODEL_DERIVED  =>  the classification is not labelled verified by the model's own confidence (see verification)
a question-intelligence record never relabels the underlying T2 question as T1_OFFICIAL
